title: LLM Interaction & Data Handling
summary: This module encompasses all components for interacting with Large Language Models, from crafting prompts and integrating various providers to parsing their outputs. It also includes utilities for text processing, data loading, and storage to support LLM applications.

nodes.label: LLM Prompting & Messaging
nodes.title: LLM Prompting & Messaging
nodes.description: Provides core components for constructing and managing prompts for LLMs, including various templates and utilities for handling message content across providers.

nodes.label: LLM Provider Integrations
nodes.title: LLM Provider Integrations
nodes.description: Offers unified interfaces and utilities for integrating with various Large Language Model providers like Anthropic, Groq, Hugging Face, Mistral AI, Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenRouter.

nodes.label: LLM Output Parsers
nodes.title: LLM Output Parsers
nodes.description: Provides various output parsers to transform raw LLM responses into structured formats like lists, XML, YAML, Pydantic objects, and includes mechanisms for fixing parsing errors.

nodes.label: Text Processing & Embeddings
nodes.title: Text Processing & Embeddings
nodes.description: Offers tools for processing and splitting text from various formats into manageable chunks, and utilities for initializing and caching text embedding models.

nodes.label: Data Loading & Storage
nodes.title: Data Loading & Storage
nodes.description: Provides components for loading data from external sources and storing it in vector databases, including in-memory and Qdrant implementations, for efficient similarity search.

edges.label: Formats input for
edges.title: Formats input for LLMs
edges.description: Prompting and messaging components prepare structured input for the various LLM providers.

edges.label: Produces raw output for
edges.title: Produces raw output for parsing
edges.description: Integrated LLM providers generate raw text or message outputs that are then processed by output parsers.

edges.label: Pre-processes text for
edges.title: Pre-processes text for prompts
edges.description: Text processing (e.g., splitting, summarization) prepares content to be incorporated into prompts.

edges.label: Generates embeddings/chunks for
edges.title: Generates embeddings/chunks for storage
edges.description: Embedding models and text splitters are crucial for preparing data to be stored and indexed in vector databases.

edges.label: Provides retrieved context to
edges.title: Provides retrieved context to prompts
edges.description: Data loaded and stored (e.g., from vector stores) is often used as context within prompts for RAG applications.

groups.label: LLM Core Interaction
groups.title: Core LLM Communication Flow
groups.description: This group manages the end-to-end process of interacting with Large Language Models, from preparing input prompts to integrating with various providers and parsing their generated outputs.

groups.label: Data Management Pipeline
groups.title: Data Preparation and Persistence
groups.description: This group handles the preparation of raw text data, including splitting and embedding, and its subsequent loading and storage in various data stores, often to support LLM context retrieval.
